name: Supreme x Nike Dunk Low SB 'Ink'
story_html: Drawn from a collaborative footwear pack, the Supreme x Nike Dunk Low SB 'Ink' employs a suede upper, featuring a charcoal base with a black signature Swoosh and inky blue overlays at the forefoot and heel. Referencing Supreme's founding year, '94' is embroidered on the lateral heel, while a standard Nike wordmark adorns the back tab. A woven Nike SB tag embellishes the stuffed mesh tongue. The sneaker rests on a blue rubber midsole with 'Supreme' debossed on the lateral sidewall.
